title: Roasted Tofu and Quinoa Bowl
subtitle: with Broccoli and Lemon Tahini Dressing
description: Top good-for-you quinoa with oven-roasted veg and peanutty tofu for a bowl that's full of flavour and goodness. Drizzle with a lemon tahini dressing to make it pop!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Peel the carrot, halve widthwise, then cut into thin wedges. Cut the onion into thin wedges.

Cook quinoa: Put the quinoa in a sieve, then rinse well and drain (see Kitchen 101). Put the quinoa in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 12-15 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for 5 mins.

Roast veggies and tofu: Meanwhile, put the broccoli, carrot and onion on a lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and turn to coat. Put the tofu on the remaining lined tray. Roast the veggies on the upper oven shelf and the tofu on the lower shelf for 20-25 mins until the veggies are tender and the tofu is golden and warmed through.

Make dressing: Juice half the lemon. Put the lemon juice, tahini, 2 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp honey and 1½ tbs water in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Slice the remaining lemon into wedges.
Serve up: Divide the quinoa among bowls and top with the roasted veggies and tofu. Drizzle over the lemon tahini dressing and serve with the lemon wedges to squeeze over. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: It’s important to rinse the quinoa well to remove the natural coating called saponin, which can make it taste bitter or soapy.
